question: In 2021, India opener Rohit Sharma became the third batsman to complete 3000 runs in T20 international cricket during a match against:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Namibia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma **completed **3000 T20 International runs**.
 
• He became the **third cricketer globally** to achieve this feat.
 
• **Rohit **reached the **3000 run** mark in a match against **Namibia **in the **ICC Men's T20 World Cup** at **Dubai International Cricket Stadium**.
 
• He's the **only batsman **to score **five centuries** in a **single edition **of the **ICC World Cup**.
 
• This **milestone** was achieved in the **2019 World Cup**.
 
• **Rohit **scored **centuries **against **South Africa**, **Pakistan**, **England**, **Bangladesh**, and **Sri Lanka**.
 
• He's the **only batsman **in **cricket history** to score **3 double centuries** in **One Day International matches**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **T20 International**

 
 
• **T20 cricket** originated in **England in 2003 **as a **professional domestic competition**.
 
• The **first official T20 International match** was played between **Australia and New Zealand** in February **2005**.
 
• **T20 International matches** follow the **rules and regulations **set by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**.
 
 
 
• **International Cricket Council**(ICC)
 
 
• **Founded** in **1909 **as the** Imperial Cricket Conference**, later renamed the **International Cricket Council **(ICC) in **1965**.
 
• **Governs international cricket**, sets **rules and regulations**, **organizes tournaments**, and **ensures fair play and integrity**.
 
• **106 member countries**, including **12 Full Members** with **Test status **and **94 Associate** and **Affiliate Members**.
